skillTree.localised_description: A small handful of Gnoblars surround this Ogre Lord, their swords always ready to cut and carve.
It never hurts to keep your lucky Gnoblar with you, just in case.
Stumpy and short-witted as they are, these Gnoblars have an eye on the sky at all times.
Puny magicks are nothing in the face of the Great Maw's endless hunger.
He lost his leg in a battle when he was young and had trouble finding a artificial leg that could take his formidable weight.

ui_effects.localised_text: Explosion does not affect friendly troops

skillTree.localised_description: He’s fought for gold, grudges, and glory. He always delivers - if paid upfront.

effects.description: Magic item drop chance from battle: +25%

skillTree.localised_description: Crafted in stone and stubbornness, the leg is tougher than most warriors.

attributes.bullet_text: The unit is immune to psychological attacks (Fear & Terror).

skillTree.localised_description: "The enemy's fear; their blood spilt in the mud – these are the things that sustain me."
The iron will and indomitable presence of this leader ensures their followers remain steadfast when facing peril.
Professional soldiery means never running out of ammo at the crucial moment.
This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.
What use armour, or even magical defences, against such powerful ordnance?
Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.
A clever arrangement of lenses makes the target seem just that bit closer.
Death is always just a shot away.
The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.
Arrows, cannonballs and more esoteric munitions are needed in endless supply on the battlefield.
Runesmiths take particular delight in the sound of the inferior works of other races breaking like icicles beneath a hammer blow.
The uncanny glow of this rune is an awe-inspiring sight, apt to fill foes with debilitating dread.
This champion extols discipline and fear away from the battlefield as much as on it.

attributes.bullet_text: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.
This unit provides a leadership bonus to nearby allies. Units within range of both the Lord's aura and an encouraging unit will receive the larger of the two bonuses.
This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.
When attacking braced charge defenders, this unit only loses half of its charge bonus
Allows the unit to attack and destroy walls in melee. This attribute also adds a  +50% damage multiplier against buildings.

items.colour_text: Finding employment with the Dwarfs he took his problem to him and was lucky enough to find a Runesmith who assigned the task to one his apprentices who created a masterful leg, even using some more advanced runes than he should really have known about.

backgroundSkills.localised_description: Gragtar bears the mark of the Fire Mouth not just in flesh, but in spirit. His presence alone radiates searing fury and divine hunger.
Funder lost his leg as a child, but after receiving a wonderful prosthetic leg from a dwarf with powerful runes, he begins to live a new life.
